mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1, indicating strengthening economic demand, boosts consumer and business confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of quarters with positive GDPC1 growth, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 5%, signaling a tightening monetary cycle, investors anticipate reduced borrowing capacity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 5%, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between rising PAYEMS (indicating a strong labor market) and low UNRATE (< 4%) creates a 'goldilocks' zone, where the economy is neither too hot nor too cold, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.04 over any 1.5-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in the 'goldilocks' zone are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month consecutive decline in INDPRO, signaling reduced industrial production, precedes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to anticipated supply chain disruptions.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 55% of instances with 2-month consecutive INDPRO declines, or Rank IC < 0.025 over any 2.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in RSAFS, indicating rising retail sales, directly boosts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate increased consumer spending.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns following RSAFS increases are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL, where low interest rates (< 4%) meet high inflation (> 3% annualized), creates a risk environment leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 50% of instances with FEDFUNDS < 4% and CPIAUCSL > 3%, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in UNRATE (< 0.5pp decline in 1 month), indicating an unexpectedly strong labor market, surprises investors, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances with sudden UNRATE drops, or Rank IC < 0.015 over any 1.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The combination of increasing HOUST (new housing starts) and GDPC1, signaling a strong housing market within a growing economy, leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.035 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in the described housing and economic growth environment are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
